source_units.text: A perfume appreciation class asks me to describe a fragrance as it changes.
Organize my study of its composition structure.
Use only dates from 2027-02-01 through 2027-02-06, including the final date.
I can spare at most 65 minutes per day, counting every topic together.
Include "Top Notes", "Heart Notes", "Base Notes", using those topic names.
Allocate at least 10 cumulative minutes to every topic.
Within that coverage, "Top Notes" needs at least 20 total minutes.
